record.question: Present Minister of Health & Family Welfare Department of Mizoram is
record.explanation: Answer D: Lalthanzara. Lal Thanzara was Mizoram's Health Minister in the period of the October 2016 exam. Pachhunga University College's original report of its September 2016 awareness event identifies him as Health Department Minister; March 2017 Assembly proceedings confirm the portfolio. Historical/source note: Historical October 2016 officeholder; source Lalthanzara denotes Lal Thanzara. Reference: https://pucollege.edu.in/storage/Departments/Psychology/Observances%20of%20World%20Suicide%20Prevention%20Day%202016.pdf; https://mizoramassembly.in/storage/Assembly/Proceedings/State/Seventh_Assembly/12th_Session/Mizo/2017/mi_pro21032017.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
